name: Pack the Hold
tagline: Find room for the most valuable cargo.
description: A timed packing race. Everyone gets the same crates and hold. Rotate and fit cargo without overlaps; each round scores your value divided by the proven optimum.
howToPlay: Drag crates into the hold; rotate them to fit.
Pack the most valuable cargo before your turn ends.
Your packed value divided by the best possible value is your score.

settings.label: Packing difficulty
settings.description: Calibrated against a reproducible greedy packing policy, not human players.
